verdict.rationale: The evidence has no explicit no-training policy or AI-training opt-out. The only relevant support is indirect: Twenty can be self-hosted, and the docs pitch this to privacy-conscious organizations that need to own their data end to end. That keeps CRM data on your own infrastructure but does not show what happens to data sent to AI providers. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that customer data is not used for model training, a documented opt-out or zero-retention terms for the AI and LLM providers behind the chatbot and agents, coverage for the cloud-hosted offering, and independent corroboration.
